prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.6 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.1 °C (59% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). Minor delay in pressure rise and slight inter-sensor switching lag indicate beginning valve actuation lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 360 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.6 bar (2% below healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.1 °C (68% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.4 °C (50% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.8 °C (57% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.85 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.59 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (6% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.5 bar (2% below healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
